headline: Sensex surges over 1,500 points as Nifty crosses 25,800 on strong FII inflows and lower crude

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign fund inflows and FII buying boost Indian market sentiment
Lower crude oil prices support economic outlook and investor sentiment
Reverse AI trade helping spark a bumper rally in benchmark indices
Heavy buying across FMCG and private banking stocks leading the market gains
whatHappening: Sensex surged past 84,000 points, gaining over 1,500 to 2,000 points intraday
Nifty 50 reclaimed 25,800 and touched intraday highs near 25,951
Union Cabinet approved an ₹11,000 crore scheme for construction equipment manufacturing
PhonePe revived its IPO plans targeting up to ₹1.4 lakh crore valuation
summary: Indian equity markets posted a massive rally on 25 November 2026, with the Sensex jumping over 1,500 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,800. The gains were driven by foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, and buying in FMCG and private banks. Among stock specific news, Wipro will absorb 3,000 bp staff across India, Hungary, and Malaysia.
